sql: WITH employees AS (SELECT id, email FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, sha256(concat($1, sluice_src.email::varchar)) AS email, sluice_src.ssn, sluice_src.salary, sluice_src.notes FROM pg.hr.employees sluice_src) employees) SELECT employees.email, x.email AS again FROM employees JOIN (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, sha256(concat($2, sluice_src.email::varchar)) AS email, sluice_src.ssn, sluice_src.salary, sluice_src.notes FROM pg.hr.employees sluice_src) x ON x.id = employees.id
